392.text: Yaṁ padacchadoyevāti (mudditapotthake), yaṁ panacchedeyevāti (likhitatālīpattapotthake), yaṁ padacchedeyevāti (madhuṭīkāyaṁ)

396.text: Saṁvisattesu dhammesu, yaṁ seṭṭhaṁ tadūpāgamiṁ (Khu 2. 221; Ma 2. 308 piṭṭhesu)

632.text: Samānatakkehi (Ka) pamāṇatakkasādhanopālambho siddhantāviruddho pañcāvayavopapanno pakkhapaṭipakkhapariggaho vādo (Nyāyadassane 1. 2. 1 suttaṁ)

633.text: Dosappasañjānanaṁ (Ka) sapakkhadosātyupagamā parapakkhadosappasaṅgo matānuññā, Nyāyadassane 5. 2. 21 suttaṁ.
Appasiddhantaraṁ (Ka) siddhantamabhyupeccāniyamā kathāpasaṅgo apasiddhanto, Nyāyadassane 5. 2. 23 suttaṁ.
Paṭiññāpaññāso (Ka) paṭiññāsaṁnyāso (saṁ + ni + asa + ṇa) iti Nyāyadassane 5. 2. 5 sutte.

728.text: Abhi-Ṭṭha 1. 72; Apadāna-Ṭṭha 1. 55; Buddhavaṁsa-Ṭṭha 316; Cariyāpiṭaka-Ṭṭha 332; Jātaka-Ṭṭha 1. 53 piṭṭhesu.

777.text: Chalaṁ nāma tividhaṁ vācāchalaṁ, sāmaññachalaṁ, upacārachalañcāti. Vitthāro pana Nyāyadassane 1. 2. 11, 12, 13, 14 suttesu passitabbo.
